body: Some of the toughest fights happen outside the Octagon. This Men’s Mental Health Awareness Month, Skilled Trades College is teaming up with UFC Canada to bring the conversation somewhere different: the mind. On November 25th, UFC fighters malott, , , and are joining them for a special panel about mental health, overcoming setbacks, and what it really means to be strong. Because getting knocked down is part of life. But you don’t have to get back up alone. November 25th.

source_caption_text:
Some of the toughest fights happen outside the Octagon. 🥊🧠

This Men’s Mental Health Awareness Month, Skilled Trades College is teaming up with UFC Canada to bring the conversation somewhere different: the mind.

On November 25th, UFC fighters @michael.malott, @jasminejasudavicius, @chovancekmma, and @charlesjourdain1 are joining them for a special panel about mental health, overcoming setbacks, and what it really means to be strong. 💪

Because getting knocked down is part of life. But you don’t have to get back up alone.

📅 November 25th. Check @stc_canada for more details! 👀
